content: Employer-side free-tool landscape: the closest free Article-9-ish artefact found is Justly's Google Sheets gender+ethnicity pay gap calculator (mean/median, bonus gap, quartiles, 'equality timer'), UK-metric-shaped rather than Article 9-shaped, with an explicit no-warranty disclaimer and a caution that under ~30 employees the unadjusted gap is misleading. No free browser-only Article 9 calculator found.
